summary.headline: PI Industries Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 17,023 million with 57% gross margin and 22% EBITDA margin; FY27 growth guided to lower single digit.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue was Rs 17,023 million with gross margin of 57% and EBITDA of Rs 3,693 million (22% margin), amid soft exports and cyclical domestic headwinds. Exports saw volume down 8% and value down 12% YoY, while domestic volume grew 12% but revenue only 3%. Subsidiary losses, driven by global biologicals and pharma ramp-up, were about Rs 100 crore at EBITDA level in the quarter. Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth in the lower single digits and expects FY27 to beat FY26 on an export recovery in the second half.

financial_highlights.value: Reduced by 19 days, releasing Rs 300 crore cash

segments.name: Agchem exports (CSM)
segments.commentary: Export volume down 8% and value down 12% YoY; new products contributed 16-18% of CSM revenue in Q1. Management cited soft commodity prices, genericization and tariffs as pressures.

segments.name: Domestic agri
segments.commentary: Volume up 12% but revenue up only 3%, reflecting price pressure; management said it prioritised market share over price. Flagship brands include Nominee Gold, Brofreya and Biovita.

segments.name: Biologicals
segments.commentary: Grew 50% with a three-year CAGR of 15%; global biologicals are loss-making due to market development spend (1,000+ grower engagements, 500+ field trials).

segments.name: Pharma / CRDMO
segments.commentary: Platform across Jaipur, Hyderabad and Lodi (Italy); some orders delayed to later quarters. Management described a long J-curve; company does not disclose molecule names.

segments.name: Electronic and specialty chemicals
segments.commentary: A commercial plant is operational and commercial supplies have started; management said the segment is not yet substantial in revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided to lower single digit, contingent on cycle.
FY27 expected to be better than FY26, driven by export recovery in H2, new launches and scale-up of pharma and global biologicals.
FY27 capex guidance of Rs 700-800 crore; Q1 capex about Rs 250 crore.
R&D spend kept at 3-4% of revenue.
Pioxaniliprole (first NCE) expected domestic launch within FY27 pending regulatory approval; other geographies in later years.
Gross margin target to be maintained via optimisation; management gave no explicit EBITDA margin guidance.
capex_capacity: Capex for Q1 about Rs 250-260 crore, spread across existing manufacturing, new verticals and innovation-led geographies/products.
Commissioned one of the world's largest flow chemistry plants.
Commercial plant for electronic chemicals is operational.
QC lab commissioned at Italy (Lodi) site, approved by regulators.
Centre of excellence for drug discovery at Hyderabad CRO facility.
demand_pricing: Management said global crop protection demand is showing early signs of stabilisation, but pricing pressure remains from weak demand and high input costs.
Domestic sowing said to be at par with last year after delays; chemical pre-placement and sales were affected.
Management said price escalation was mainly in generics, while PI focused on market share.
Export pricing and growth pressured by soft commodity prices, genericization pressures and tariffs.
Brazil nematicide market about USD 750 million; company aims for double-digit share over 5-10 years.
Global biologicals market about USD 10 billion, growing double digits.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 revenue growth guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated lower single-digit growth and a positive trajectory, depending on the cycle.

qa_highlights.question: How should margins be viewed through the year?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to sustain gross margins at the best possible levels through optimisation; it did not give an EBITDA margin figure.

qa_highlights.question: When will Pioxaniliprole launch?
qa_highlights.answer: Early start expected this year and India launch within the year, subject to regulatory approvals; other geographies planned for next year and the year after.

qa_highlights.question: Why did currency benefits not reflect in exports?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said currency benefits are shared with customers under a pass-through model, with some currency risk management, and margins are managed at an optimal level.

qa_highlights.question: What is the subsidiary loss and when does it break even?
qa_highlights.answer: Losses reflect front-loaded investment in pharma and global biologicals (market development, human resources); management gave no breakeven timeline and said it would try to provide quarterly biologicals numbers.

qa_highlights.question: Is the pharma guidance intact after order delays?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said delays are sequential timing shifts from new customers and products; it did not quantify the delay.

risks_watch: Export volume decline (-8%) and value decline (-12%) despite rupee depreciation of around 13% YoY, with management giving limited explanation of the gap.
Subsidiary losses of around Rs 100 crore EBITDA in Q1 from biologicals and pharma; no breakeven timeline given.
Pricing pressure in domestic agri and exports, plus input cost and inventory overhangs.
Pharma order delays and high volatility in CRDMO revenue.
Pioxaniliprole regulatory approvals and efficacy data, which were not disclosed on the call.
Biologicals growth depends on farmer habit change, which management flagged as slow.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term strategy and R&D, but cautious and somewhat evasive on near-term pricing, margins, subsidiary losses and pharma timing. Management repeatedly deferred specifics (molecule lists, efficacy data, the export currency gap) to future launches.
key_quotes: While the quarter witnessed softness amidst cyclical headwinds and global disruptions, we are steadily transitioning towards a growth trajectory.
Despite a challenging operating environment in the domestic market, we delivered a 12% volume growth in this quarter, translating into a 3% revenue growth.

adds.what: One of the world's largest flow chemistry plants (commissioned)
Electronic and specialty chemicals commercial plant (operational, commercial supplies started)
Pioxaniliprole first NCE domestic launch (product launch, not capacity; pending regulatory approval)

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guided to lower single digit (~2% midpoint, held, contingent on cycle), with FY27 expected better than FY26 on H2 export recovery; backing is partial, with a flow chemistry plant and e-chem plant already commissioned, capex of Rs 700-800 crore, and pioxaniliprole launch pending approval, but export volume fell 8% and value 12% YoY.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management gave no EBITDA margin guidance and only aims to hold gross margin (57% in Q1) via optimisation, while subsidiary losses of about Rs 100 crore EBITDA per quarter and domestic price pressure weigh on EBITDA margin (22% in Q1).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Flow chemistry plant and e-chem commercial plant are already commissioned, and FY27 capex guidance of Rs 700-800 crore with about Rs 250-260 crore spent in Q1 implies further capacity additions through the year, though no specific new plant dates were given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Domestic volume grew 12% in Q1 and sowing is at par with last year, but export volume fell 8% YoY, so group volume growth depends on an H2 export recovery that management has not quantified.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is firmly guided at Rs 700-800 crore for FY27, but utilisation was not disclosed, so a fresh capex announcement beyond existing guidance is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth held at lower single digit (about 2% midpoint) and contingent on the cycle, with exports down 12% in value and pharma orders delayed.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Export value fell 12% YoY despite rupee depreciation of about 13%, pharma orders slipped to later quarters without quantification, and pricing pressure persists in domestic agri and exports.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.when: within FY27 (India); other geographies in FY28-FY29
rows.why: Pioxaniliprole, the first NCE, is guided for a domestic launch within FY27 pending regulatory approval, and new products contributed 16-18% of CSM revenue in Q1.

rows.label: Subsidiary losses (pharma and global biologicals) with no breakeven timeline
rows.why: Losses are about Rs 100 crore EBITDA in Q1 from front-loaded investment, and management gave no breakeven timeline, so the drag on consolidated EBITDA should persist.

rows.label: Net working capital release
rows.why: NWC fell by 19 days, releasing about Rs 300 crore of cash, and the company is debt-free with net cash of Rs 3,800 crore.

rows.label: Order book stable at USD 1.2 billion
rows.why: The order book held sequentially at USD 1.2 billion, which supports the expected H2 export recovery, though management did not quantify conversion.

tone.note: Management was confident on long-term strategy, R&D and biologicals growth (up 50%), but cautious and somewhat evasive on export currency gaps, subsidiary loss breakeven, pharma order timing and EBITDA margin, which analysts pushed on.
